expected_edit: add v2 Hello and Heartbeat while keeping unversioned ping

files.body:
Version 2 will expand the protocol beyond the current ping message with additional message types, clearer encoding and decoding rules, and stronger validation for malformed or unknown input. The work will preserve compatibility where practical, document the updated wire format, and add focused tests so the new behavior is stable before release.

Shipped in v2: added `Msg::Hello(String)` using the explicit `v:2|hello|<payload>` envelope while preserving the existing ping message path.
